root_motivation: truth-tier 10-20: claude_code satisfaction 0.55 (n=9), recipe completion 0.00: "I have no file-reading tool (no Read/Bash/Glob) and no MCP resource exposes the CSV, so I can't get the 1,000 rows into" a table. abandon-other 1 with the same text. mcphost-resources-for-tenant-data is built, but resources list tables, docs and runs the tenant already has; an uploaded CSV is not one of them.
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a `host.table.create` call with `source_url` to a served 1,000-row CSV with header, When the call completes, Then the table exists with 1,000 rows, inferred column types, and the result reports `rows_imported 1000, rows_skipped 0, source url`

Given `source_url` values resolving to 127.0.0.1, 10.0.0.1, 169.254.169.254, fd00::1, an http:// URL, and an https URL redirecting to http, When `host.table.append` is called, Then each returns `import_url_forbidden` naming the host and the fetch counter records zero bytes received
Given a served CSV larger than the plan cap, When imported, Then the result is `import_too_large` with `data.bytes` equal to the cap and the table is unchanged
Given `csv_text` of 50 lines with one malformed row, When appended to an existing table, Then 49 rows land, `rows_skipped 1`, and the first skip reason names the line number and column
Given a call supplying both `rows` and `source_url`, When host-args validation runs, Then it is refused by the inputSchema `oneOf` before the handler runs, with the refusal naming both fields
Given the error-codes registry, When the import codes are added, Then the generated contract and both SDKs carry them and the registry drift test passes with no hand edit to the contract

Given prod /mcp in a real Claude Code session on orch with only mcphost tools allowed, When the prompt is the recipe text "create a table named tblurl_ac07 from https://mcphost.dev/examples/sample-1000.csv and tell me the row count", Then the transcript shows a successful `host_table_create` result and a `host_table_count` result of 1000 (Live; evidence: `~/.local/state/mcphost-live/tblurl-ac07.jsonl` from the AC 7 command in § Live evidence commands)

acceptance_criteria.description: Given two `host.table.append` calls with the same `import_id` within 24 h, When the second runs, Then it returns the first result and the row count does not change

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
